summary: Nexa Resources filed a Form 6-K confirming awareness of ongoing negotiations between its controlling shareholder Votorantim S.A. and Boliden AB regarding a potential transaction that would impact Nexa. No specific terms (stake size, price per share, premium) were disclosed. The company has no certainty an agreement will be reached and will not comment further until appropriate. This is a preliminary-stage M&A rumor/confirmation without a definitive agreement or formal proposal. The risk-arb angle is to monitor for a binding offer or further disclosures.
